error.message: Seal the value with secretseal to the target's published seal key (GET /targets/{id}/seal-key) and send Envelope.Encode().
Broker injection settings: an extra header names a header the broker never injects.
The envelope is sealed to another seal key than the one the target publishes; fetch the seal key again and reseal.
The target's host has not published a host-signed seal key yet. Start a current agentgate-hostd on it and wait for its next poll.
The target has not published a host-signed seal key; no envelope can be sealed to it.

Secret bare-key has no broker rules, so it allows nothing (deny by default). Recreate it with explicit rules, for example [{"methods":["POST"],"path":"/v1/messages","match":"exact"}], or with the wildcard [{"methods":["*"],"path":"/"}] to allow every method and path of its upstreams.
